headline: Reddit’s AI is turning posts into podcasts and short videos
summary: Reddit is experimenting with AI to convert text posts into audio and video. This new feature aims to offer users alternative content consumption methods. AI voices will read main posts and selected comments in the video adaptations.

headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show focusing on trending social media topics. The program highlights stories people are actively discussing and searching online. 'Searched' began airing in April on ABC News Live, including Disney Plus.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The 65-percent Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99 at Woot. This deal is perfect for those exploring custom mechanical keyboards without a huge investment. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING at checkout for the discounted price.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: Game designer Sam Rosenthal, known for Blaseball, created a new word game called 'Dartwords.' The game combines elements inspired by Wordle with a Clippy-like assistant. Rosenthal aims to innovate within the daily word game genre.

headline: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale From Newegg via AliExpress
summary: The ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor is currently on sale. It functions perfectly as a secondary monitor for your laptop setup. This portable display also enhances gaming for Nintendo Switch or Steam Deck users.

headline: James Gunn Defends the Tonal Shift of the DCU After Lanterns Stirs Conversation With Gritty First Episode
summary: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has defended the varied tonal approach of the new DCU. This defense comes after the gritty first episode of 'Lanterns' sparked debate. Gunn clarifies the DCU will not maintain a single, uniform tone across its projects.

headline: Amazon's Game of Thrones T-Shirt Sale Has Some Great House of the Dragon Designs
summary: Amazon is hosting a sale on Game of Thrones themed T-shirts. The collection features appealing designs inspired by 'House of the Dragon.' Fans can find new apparel from the popular fantasy series.

headline: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Drops to $1,198 with Free Shipping on Amazon
summary: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV is now priced at $1,198 on Amazon. This offer includes free shipping, making it an excellent deal. The S90F model was previously recognized as the best gaming TV in 2026.

headline: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
summary: Donald Trump reportedly threatened to bomb US ally Oman. The threat comes amid ongoing negotiations for an Iran deal. Oman has been involved in separate talks to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

headline: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere has died at the age of 36, prompting an outpouring of tributes. The star was known for her roles in TV shows like 'Heroes' and 'Nashville.' A coroner's report found no signs of trauma in her death.

headline: Fifa executive leaves job three weeks after speaking out against Infantino plan
summary: Senior FIFA executive Kevin Lamour has been dismissed from his position. His departure follows criticism he voiced against President Gianni Infantino's plans. Lamour's sacking occurred just three weeks after his public comments.

headline: Young adults are taking prescription drugs instead of alcohol - and it's dividing experts
summary: A growing trend sees young adults using prescription drugs, like anxiety medication, to achieve a 'drunk' feeling. This practice has led to divided opinions among experts regarding its implications. Experts warn that substituting alcohol with prescription drugs may carry unforeseen consequences.
